business_summary: Shenzhen Aoni Electronic Co., Ltd. engages in the research, development, manufacture, and sale of audio-visual hardware products in China and internationally. The company offers intelligent video terminal products, such as low-power, indoor, outdoor, office and teaching, conference, and human verification cameras, as well as smart video doorbells, NVR kits, and baby care products. It also provides high-performance computing terminals, including laptops, AI PCs, and flat products; intelligent vehicle terminals consisting of vehicle cameras, smart dashcams, streaming rearview mirrors, electronic exterior rearview mirrors, and AEBS autonomous collision avoidance systems; smart audio terminals, including OWS headphones, headphones, and conference equipment; and smart pet terminals, including cat litter boxes, feeders, water feeders, and bird feeders. In addition, the company offers lobster reasoning computing power products comprising personal AI super lobster reasoning workstations, enterprise-grade AI lobster inference servers, and PC farms. Further, it provides Aoni Agent and Aoraco cloud platforms, as well as token factory products, including computing power operations. The company's products are used in AI computing power solutions, smart home, smart mobility, and smart office applications. Additionally, it is involved in property management; investing in real estate and industries; real estate leasing; trading; and software and information technology services. The company was founded in 2005 and is headquartered in Shenzhen, China.
